title: Flamenco Embers (Spain Instrumental)
style: Spanish flamenco guitar pure instrumental cajón palmas clapping soleares falseta 88bpm warm traditional Andalusia no vocals passionate cinematic embers dark textural
lyrics:
[Instrumental — flamenco guitar, cajón, palmas clapping]

[Opening — single guitar, falseta intro]

[Cajón enters — soleares rhythm pattern]

[Palmas join — handclapping cross-rhythm]

[Full flamenco texture — guitar soars]

[Guitar solo — deep cante jondo feel]

[Resolution — guitar alone]

[Fade]
